proof_body:
by
  intro a M h
  have hb : Filter.IsBoundedUnder (· ≤ ·) Filter.atTop a :=
    Filter.isBoundedUnder_of ⟨M, fun n => (le_abs_self _).trans (h n)⟩
  have hb' : Filter.IsBoundedUnder (· ≥ ·) Filter.atTop a :=
    Filter.isBoundedUnder_of ⟨-M, fun n => (abs_le.1 (h n)).1⟩
  have hf : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ᶠ n in Filter.atTop, |a n - Filter.limsup a Filter.atTop| < 1 / ((k : ℝ) + 1) := by
    intro k
    have hp : 0 < 1 / ((k : ℝ) + 1) := by positivity
    have h1 : ∃ᶠ n in Filter.atTop, Filter.limsup a Filter.atTop - 1 / ((k : ℝ) + 1) < a n :=
      Filter.frequently_lt_of_lt_limsup hb'.isCoboundedUnder_le (by linarith)
    have h2 : ∀ᶠ n in Filter.atTop, a n < Filter.limsup a Filter.atTop + 1 / ((k : ℝ) + 1) :=
      Filter.eventually_lt_of_limsup_lt (by linarith) hb
    exact (h1.and_eventually h2).mono fun n hn => abs_lt.2 ⟨by linarith [hn.1], by linarith [hn.2]⟩
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hp2⟩ := Filter.extraction_forall_of_frequently hf
  refine ⟨p, hp, Metric.tendsto_atTop.2 fun ε hε => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨K, hK⟩ := exists_nat_one_div_lt hε
  refine ⟨K, fun n hn => ?_⟩
  rw [Real.dist_eq]
  have h2 : 1 / ((n : ℝ) + 1) ≤ 1 / ((K : ℝ) + 1) := by
    apply one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by positivity)
    have h3 : (K : ℝ) ≤ n := by exact_mod_cast hn
    linarith
  exact ((hp2 n).trans_le h2).trans hK
target_source: ∀ (a : ℕ → ℝ) (M : ℝ), (∀ n, |a n| ≤ M) → ∃ p : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono p ∧ Filter.Tendsto (fun n => a (p n)) Filter.atTop (nhds (Filter.limsup a Filter.atTop))
